title: 2007 HMMT February Calculus Problem 2
statement: Determine the real number \(a\) having the property that \(f(a)=a\) is a relative minimum of \(f(x)=\) \(x^{4}-x^{3}-x^{2}+a x+1\).

solutions.text: 1. Being a relative minimum, we have \(0=f^{\prime}(a)=4 a^{3}-3 a^{2}-2 a+a=a(4 a+1)(a-1)\). Then \(a=0,1,-1 / 4\) are the only possibilities. However, it is easily seen that \(a=1\) is the only value satisfying \(f(a)=a\).
